# BuildEstimate AI

> BuildEstimate AI is a high-precision, AI-powered construction estimation platform for residential and commercial projects. It delivers real-time line-item cost projections, 5-year ROI forecasts, timeline estimates, risk analyses, and contractor efficiency tips.

## Core Capabilities
- **Project Cost Analysis**: Generates comprehensive line-item breakdowns across Labor, Materials, Permits, Overhead, and Profit Margin.
- **5-Year ROI Forecasting**: Projects property appreciation, energy savings, or revenue yields based on project scope and location.
- **Commercial vs Residential Engine**: Adapts structural calculation algorithms to project scale and regulatory requirements.
- **Offline Estimation Engine**: Operates defensively without external API keys, providing instant calibrated fallback estimates.
- **BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)**: Supports user-provided Gemini API keys for custom AI generation.

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 + Motion
- **Data Visualization**: Recharts (Pie charts, Line charts for ROI)
- **AI Integration**: Google GenAI SDK (@google/genai) with structured JSON schemas
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant with keyboard navigation (`Alt+1`, `Alt+2`, `Alt+3`), ARIA live announcements, high-contrast focus indicators.
